name: with-inside-the-code-of-with-names-a-value-of-each-stage
query: apply ([85 92 47 78 68 95 52] | with {:allScores it} (filter (gte 70) | with {:passingScores it} (get [(allScores | count), (passingScores | count)])))

name: a-word-after-the-body-of-a-declaration-is-refused-naming-the-semicolon
expect: "a declaration ends with `;` before what follows it: write `:name body; …`"

name: the-top-declares-a-kind-a-verb-and-a-node-under-a-noun
query: :Box |~~ A box. ~~|; :number/double mul 2; :Box/side |~~ The side of a box. ~~|; :Box/fits |~~ A box fits. ~~| ::law~(true); 5 | double | get [it (::Box/side | doc | content) (::Box | laws | keys)]

name: a-body-reads-a-label-by-its-bare-name
query: :K |~~ A kind. ~~| (::kind | accepts |~~ x ~~| ::map); :Box |~~ A box. ~~| K; get [(::Box{:a 1} | tag) (::Box#5 !| tag)]

name: a-verb-called-where-no-value-is-in-the-pipe-is-refused-naming-it
query: get [(~(:x (!| 1 | count);) | answer !| get [tag name]) (~(:x (!| 1 | vec/count);) | answer !| get [tag name]) (~(:x (!| 1 | nosuch);) | answer !| tag)]

name: a-program-carries-the-values-of-its-text-it-reads
query: :limit 4; :big (gt limit); :little gt 9; :number/odd (mod 2 | eq 1); get [([1 5 10] | filter big) ([1 5 10] | filter little) ([1 2 3] | filter odd) (::big | binding | value)]

name: a-quote-under-a-name-carries-nothing-of-its-text
query: :limit 4; :big ~(gt limit); get [([1 5 10] | filter big !| get [tag name]) (big) (with {:q (big | fill {:limit 4})} ([1 5 10] | filter q))]
